cases.spec_ref: AGS4 Rule 6 forbids a CR/LF WITHIN a field and offers no in-field escape. compat.dataframe_to_AGS4 once wrote the newline RAW, tearing the DATA row across two physical lines — an illegal file (#423). Post-#518 the shared writer REFUSES it; the leg and the leaf must both refuse (`EmbeddedNewline`).

The happy path: with no embedded newline, compat.dataframe_to_AGS4 and the rust-leaf write the SAME bytes — both route the same cell matrix through write_ags4_matrix in the compat shape (trailing blank line).
